## Motivation

Request logs rotate hourly, but rotated files are never removed. Operators can now set a retention period for request log files; leaving it unset preserves the existing unlimited-retention behavior.

Fixes #41129

## Modifications

- Adds `--log-requests-retention-days` with positive integer validation.
- Deletes expired hourly rotations for the request logger at startup and every hour, including while the server is idle. Matching is limited to the logger's current `<hostname>_<rank>.log` filename and timestamp suffixes.
- Adds CPU regression coverage for deletion, filename isolation, unset behavior, and periodic cleanup without new log records.
- Related: #45343 changes request log filenames to include the process ID. This change follows the current `<hostname>_<rank>.log` naming; happy to rebase or adapt whichever change lands first.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable; this changes logging only. The CPU unit test `test/registered/utils/test_log_utils.py` passes (7 tests).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable; inference performance is unchanged.

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).

- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable; logging only.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+def _get_rotated_log_files(filename: str) -> List[str]:
+    """Return this logger's hourly rotations, excluding similarly prefixed files."""
+    prefix = f"{filename}."
+    return [
+        path
+        for path in glob.glob(glob.escape(prefix) + "*")
+        if _ROTATED_LOG_SUFFIX_RE.fullmatch(path[len(prefix) :])
+    ]
+
+
+def _cleanup_rotated_log_files(
+    filename: str, retention_days: int, now: Optional[float] = None
+) -> None:
+    cutoff = (time.time() if now is None else now) - retention_days * 24 * 60 * 60
+    for path in _get_rotated_log_files(filename):
+        try:
+            if os.path.getmtime(path) < cutoff:
+                os.remove(path)
+        except OSError:
+            logging.getLogger(__name__).warning(
+                "Unable to remove expired request log file %s", path, exc_info=True
+            )
+
+
+def _start_log_retention_cleanup(
+    filename: str, retention_days: Optional[int]
+) -> Optional[threading.Timer]:
+    if retention_days is None:
+        return None
+    if retention_days <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("log request retention days must be positive")
+
+    _cleanup_rotated_log_files(filename, retention_days)
+    schedule_key = (os.path.abspath(filename), retention_days)
+    with _LOG_RETENTION_SCHEDULES_LOCK:
+        if schedule_key in _LOG_RETENTION_SCHEDULES:
+            return None
+        _LOG_RETENTION_SCHEDULES.add(schedule_key)
+
+    def cleanup_and_reschedule() -> None:
+        try:
+            _cleanup_rotated_log_files(filename, retention_days)
+        finally:
+            timer = threading.Timer(
+                _LOG_RETENTION_INTERVAL_SECONDS, cleanup_and_reschedule
+            )
+            timer.daemon = True
+            timer.start()
+
+    timer = threading.Timer(_LOG_RETENTION_INTERVAL_SECONDS, cleanup_and_reschedule)
+    timer.daemon = True
+    timer.start()
